targets.rawSql: select count(*) value from observability.anomaly_events where resolved_at is null
select count(*) value from (select distinct on(dataset_name) status from observability.freshness_history order by dataset_name,observed_at desc) s where status='stale'

select distinct on(dataset_name) dataset_name,layer,last_record_at,round(age_minutes,1) age_minutes,sla_minutes,status,row_count,round(volume_change_pct,1) volume_change_pct from observability.freshness_history order by dataset_name,observed_at desc
select observed_at time,age_minutes value,dataset_name metric from observability.freshness_history where $__timeFilter(observed_at) order by observed_at
select severity,anomaly_type,dataset_name,detected_at,details from observability.anomaly_events where resolved_at is null order by case severity when 'critical' then 1 else 2 end,detected_at desc
